title: Past work follow-up: a computed list of what fell through the cracks

chat.text: A script reads every task of the last 10 days and flags the ones not landed and quiet, landed but unmerged, or landed with no outcome, plus open asks with no live owner. The obvious ones get fixed by minions; Property.of (code, unmerged) goes to you. A second script lists framework files nothing references, as candidates only.
